# 10. Organizational memory / knowledge

Owner: ops control worker (part 3).

One searchable place for what the business knows, so nothing critical lives only in MEMORY.md.

**Measurable outcomes:** every decision/runbook/account/lesson in MEMORY.md is findable by keyword; zero secret values in docs (paths only).

**Acceptance:** `docs/ops/knowledge/` is generated by `scripts/ops-build-knowledge.ts` (450 entries at build time); `searchMemory` BM25 tested; `docs/ops/operating-manual.md`, `boundaries.md`, `owner-dependencies.md`, `kill-switch.md` exist; optimiser `getRelevantKnowledge` includes `ops_decision`.

**Verification:** run the script, then `... search "postal address"`; `npx vitest run src/lib/ops/control src/lib/optimizer`.

**Honest status:** the index is a snapshot: re-run the script after MEMORY.md changes (not scheduled). Redaction is pattern-based; review `index.json` before sharing it outside the repo.
